tweets.text_resolved: "The Korean miracle extends exactly as far as the armies of free nations advanced in 1953—25 miles to our North." #POTUSinAsia

tweets.text: "And so, on this peninsula we have watched the results of a tragic experiment... It is a tale of one people, but two Koreas." #POTUSinAsia
tweets.text_resolved: "And so, on this peninsula we have watched the results of a tragic experiment... It is a tale of one people, but two Koreas." #POTUSinAsia

tweets.text: "One Korea in which the people took control of their lives and their country—and chose a future of freedom and justice, of civilization and achievement." #POTUSinAsia
tweets.text_resolved: "One Korea in which the people took control of their lives and their country—and chose a future of freedom and justice, of civilization and achievement." #POTUSinAsia

tweets.text: "The more successful South Korea becomes, the more decisively you discredit the dark fantasy at the heart of the Kim regime." #POTUSinAsia
tweets.text_resolved: "The more successful South Korea becomes, the more decisively you discredit the dark fantasy at the heart of the Kim regime." #POTUSinAsia

tweets.text: "In this Republic, the people have done what no dictator ever could— you took, with the help of the United States, responsibility for yourselves and ownership of your future. You had a dream—a Koren Dream—and you built that dream into reality." #POTUSinAsia

tweets.text: "Today, I hope I speak not only for our countries, but for all civilized nations, when I say to the North: Do not underestimate us. And do not try us. We will defend our common security, our shared prosperity, and our sacred liberty." #POTUSinAsia
